title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENER - OperationModeProfile
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ener/OperationModeProfile. A resource manager can declare multiple operation modes for a device. An operation mode is a mode/state that a device can find itself in, that is associated with a specific power value. Subclass of FlexibilityProfile per the SAREF4ENER ontology; inherited properties are documented on the FlexibilityProfile model and not repeated here.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'OperationModeProfile'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

hasTimer.description: Relationship. The set of timers that are available in this Actuator or OperationModeProfile Relationship to Timer.

hasTransition.description: Relationship. The transitions between various saref:States or s4ener:OperationModes that either the Actuator or the OperationModeProfile can support. Relationship to Transition.
